features.name: FastAPI service skeleton
features.behavior: A FastAPI app in backend/ with layered packages (api, services, domain, infrastructure), a /health endpoint, typed ISSUE_TRIAGE_* settings from environment variables, and lint (ruff), typecheck (mypy --strict) and test (pytest) commands wired into the root npm scripts.
features.verification: Hitting /health returns 200 in a test; npm run lint, typecheck and test run the backend tools and pass.

features.name: GitHub issue ingestion
features.behavior: A resumable, rate-limit-aware command that fetches a target repository's issues with labels, state reason, duplicateOf link and comments through the GitHub GraphQL API into a git-ignored local store, pseudonymizing usernames, behind an issue-source adapter interface.
features.verification: Tests with recorded API responses cover pagination, resume and pseudonymization; a run against astral-sh/uv stores issues locally.

features.name: Ground-truth datasets with time split
features.behavior: Builders that derive the four evaluation sets (type labels, time-valid duplicate pairs, question to maintainer answer, needs-info) with an as-of timestamp per case, plus a committed golden sample of 50 hand-checked issues.
features.verification: Tests prove no case references data newer than its as-of timestamp and that newer-original duplicate pairs are excluded; dataset statistics are printed.

features.name: Input and output guardrails

features.verification: Tests cover redaction, injection flags and rejection of invalid model output.

features.name: LLM triage baseline and eval runner
features.behavior: An LLM classifies an issue as bug, question, enhancement or other with a confidence; an eval runner scores it on the type dataset (macro-F1, per-class F1, cost, latency p50/p95) and writes a results summary under evals/results/.
features.verification: The runner works end to end with the fake provider in tests; a real-model run's summary is committed.

features.name: Hybrid duplicate search
features.behavior: Similar-issue search combining vector and keyword (BM25) retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion, filtered to items created before the as-of timestamp, scored with recall@k and MRR on the duplicate pairs.
features.verification: Tests prove the as-of filter; the eval summary compares vector-only, keyword-only and hybrid.

features.name: Agent orchestration with a human gate
